justification: Panel A depicts a single standing human figure in elaborate frontal regalia with headdress and layered ornamentation, rendered in high-relief carving with dense symbolic detail; Panel B depicts what appears to be an animal figure (possibly quadruped) and a rider or attacker with a bow-like implement in a horizontal scene, rendered in flat linear infill against dark ground. There is no shared iconographic motif, pose, or combination of elements between the two—one is a vertical portrait-style composition of a single anthropomorphic figure, the other a horizontal narrative scene involving animal and human-like forms in action. The styles also differ fundamentally: deep sculptural relief with costume ornamentation versus flat silhouette drawing with dark/light infill.
